name: Conjugated linoleic acid (CLA)
summary: CLA is a fatty-acid supplement with weight-loss meta-analyses showing statistically significant but clinically small effects (~1 kg fat loss), accompanied by insulin-resistance concerns that complicate the risk-benefit picture.
description: Canonical Conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: body composition; fat loss; insulin sensitivity (safety signal)

research_metadata.evidence_notes: Weight-loss meta-analyses ~1kg; insulin-resistance concerns (PMIDs flagged verify-before-publishing). Debunk-leaning angle.
